an integrated microfluidics-mass spectrometry device was developed for automated protein analysis and was demonstrated to be compatible with the automated analysis and identification of proteins from complex samples.

we developed a fully automated integrated analytical system consisting a microfluidics-based separation and a tandem mass spectrometer, and that the system can be used for automated analysis of protein mixtures.

developing microfluidic systems that can be integrated with mass spectrometers to perform protein analysis.

the development and application of microfluidic devices and systems that integrate microfluidics with other analytical tools such as mass spectrometry for the automated and high-throughput analysis of proteins.
the development of a fully automated microfluidics-totandem mass spectrometer system that is capable of analyzing complex mixtures of proteins in a high-throughput mode.

we have successfully integrated microfluidics and electrospray ion-trap tandem mass spectrometry into a system for automated protein identification.
